```{r}
categorical_summary <- data |>
  select(sex, ethnicity, year) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "Variable",
               values_to = "Category") |>
  filter(!is.na(Category)) |>
  count(Variable, Category) |>
  group_by(Variable) |>
  mutate(Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

categorical_summary |>  kable (caption= "Summary Statistics",digits=2)
```

# Correlation

```{r}
# Load required package
# Select variables for correlations
cor_data <- data[, c(
  "CN_S", "CN_A", "CN_I", "CN_C", "CN_M",
  "M_S", "M_B", "M_Se", "M_Sa",
  "EI_Ch", "EI_Cu", "EI_I", "EI_E", "EI_P", "EI_D",
  "MC_S", "MC_P",
  "NE_N", "NE_O", "NE_C", "EQ",
  "LS", "FC", "gpa")]


variable_labels <- c(
  CN_S  = "CN_Security",
  CN_A  = "CN_Acceptance",
  CN_I  = "CN_Initiative",
  CN_C  = "CN_Competence",
  CN_M  = "CN_Meaning",
  M_S   = "M_Safety",
  M_B   = "M_Belonging",
  M_Se  = "M_Self-esteem",
  M_Sa  = "M_Self-actualization",
  EI_Ch = "EI_Challenge",
  EI_Cu = "EI_Curiosity",
  EI_I  = "EI_Independence Mastery",
  EI_E  = "EI_Easy work",
  EI_P  = "EI_Pleasing",
  EI_D  = "EI_Dependence on teacher",
  MC_S  = "MC_Self-achievement",
  MC_P  = "MC_Power",
  
  EQ    = "Emotional Intelligence",
  NE_N  = "NE_Neuroticism",
  NE_O  = "NE_Openness",
  NE_C  = "NE_Conscientiousness",
  LS    = "Letter Sets",
  FC    = "Figure Classification",
  NS_S  = "Security satisfaction",
  NS_A  = "Acceptance satisfaction",
  NS_I  = "Initiative satisfaction",
  NS_C  = "Self-efficacy satisfaction",
  NS_M  = "Meaning satisfaction",
  gpa   = "GPA"
)

names(cor_data) <- unname(variable_labels[names(cor_data)])


intercor_matrix <- cor(cor_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")

print(intercor_matrix)

corr_test <- psych::corr.test(cor_data, use = "pairwise", method = "pearson", 
                              adjust = "none")
print(corr_test$r)|>  kable (digits=2)   # Correlation coefficients
print(corr_test$p)|>  kable (digits=2)    # p-values



r <- corr_test$r
p <- corr_test$p

stars <- ifelse(p < .001, "***", ifelse(p < .01, "**", ifelse(p < .05, "*", "")))

corr_table <- matrix(
  paste0(round(r, 2), stars),
  nrow = nrow(r),
  dimnames = dimnames(r))

corr_table |> kable(digits = 2)

##cleaner
corr_table <- as.data.frame(corr_table)
corr_table
```

```{r}


# Open a large, high-resolution image
png(
  "correlation_plot.png",
  width = 16, height = 14, units = "in",
  res = 300, pointsize = 12, bg = "white"
)

corrplot::corrplot(
  round(corr_test$r, 1),
  method = "color",
  type = "lower",          # shows only half of the matrix
  diag = FALSE,            # removes the 1.00 diagonal

  
  addCoef.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.85,        # makes correlation numbers smaller
  
  number.font = 2,
  
  tl.cex = 0.8,            # makes variable names smaller
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45,
  
  p.mat = corr_test$p,     # gives corrplot the p-values
  sig.level = 0.05,
  insig = "blank"          # hides nonsignificant correlations
)



# Finish saving the image
dev.off()
```

# CFA

### First Order

```{r}
# Define CFA model

CN_model1 <- '

Security =~ CN_1_1 + CN_1_2 + CN_1_3 + CN_1_4 + CN_1_5 + CN_1_6 + CN_1_7 + CN_1_8

Acceptance =~ CN_2_1 + CN_2_2 + CN_2_3 + CN_2_4 + CN_2_5 + CN_2_6 + CN_2_7 +CN_2_8

Initiative =~ CN_3_1 + CN_3_2 + CN_3_3 + CN_3_4 +CN_3_5 + CN_3_6 + CN_3_7 + CN_3_8

Competence =~ CN_4_1 + CN_4_2 + CN_4_3 + CN_4_4 +CN_4_5 + CN_4_6 + CN_4_7 + CN_4_8

Meaning =~ CN_5_1 + CN_5_2 + CN_5_3 + CN_5_4 + CN_5_5 + CN_5_6 + CN_5_7 + CN_5_8

'

fit_CN1 <- cfa(CN_model1, data = data, std.lv = TRUE, 
              missing = "fiml",estimator = "MLR")


summary(fit_CN1,
        fit.measures = TRUE,
        standardized = TRUE)

#Main Fit Indice
fitMeasures(fit_CN1, c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))

#Corelations among factors
lavInspect(fit_CN1, "cor.lv")

#modification indices
modificationIndices(fit_CN1,
                    sort. = TRUE,
                    minimum.value = 10)


#Plot

# Open a high-resolution PNG
png(
  "CN1_CFA.png",
  width = 14, height = 22, units = "in",
  res = 300, pointsize = 12, bg = "white"
)

semPlot::semPaths(
  fit_CN1,
  what = "paths",
  whatLabels = "std",          # Standardized estimates
  layout = "tree2",
  rotation = 2,               # Factors left, items right
  
  nCharNodes = 0,              # Show full variable names
  nDigits = 2,
  sizeMan = 6,
  sizeMan2 = 2.5,
  sizeLat = 10,
  sizeLat2 = 5,
  edge.label.cex = 0.9,
  
  residuals = FALSE,
  intercepts = FALSE,
  exoCov = TRUE,               # Show factor correlations
  
  color = list(lat = "#D8E8F5", man = "white"),
  edge.color = "black",
  fade = FALSE,
  normalize = FALSE,
  mar = c(4, 8, 4, 4)
)

# Finish saving
dev.off()

```

### Second Order

```{r}
# Define CFA model

CN_model2 <- '

Security =~ CN_1_1 + CN_1_2 + CN_1_3 + CN_1_4 + CN_1_5 + CN_1_6 + CN_1_7 + CN_1_8

Acceptance =~ CN_2_1 + CN_2_2 + CN_2_3 + CN_2_4 + CN_2_5 + CN_2_6 + CN_2_7 +CN_2_8

Initiative =~ CN_3_1 + CN_3_2 + CN_3_3 + CN_3_4 +CN_3_5 + CN_3_6 + CN_3_7 + CN_3_8

Competence =~ CN_4_1 + CN_4_2 + CN_4_3 + CN_4_4 +CN_4_5 + CN_4_6 + CN_4_7 + CN_4_8

Meaning =~ CN_5_1 + CN_5_2 + CN_5_3 + CN_5_4 + CN_5_5 + CN_5_6 + CN_5_7 + CN_5_8

CoreNeed =~ Security + Acceptance + Initiative + Competence + Meaning

'

fit_CN2 <- cfa(CN_model2, data = data, std.lv = TRUE, 
              missing = "fiml",estimator = "MLR")


summary(fit_CN2,
        fit.measures = TRUE,
        standardized = TRUE)

#Main Fit Indice
fitMeasures(fit_CN2, c("cfi", "tli", "rmsea", "srmr"))

#Corelations among factors
lavInspect(fit_CN2, "cor.lv")

#modification indices
modificationIndices(fit_CN2,
                    sort. = TRUE,
                    minimum.value = 10)

```

# PCA

```{r}


# Select variables
data_PCA1 <- data[, c(
  "CN_S", "CN_A", "CN_I", "CN_C", "CN_M",
  "M_S", "M_B", "M_Se", "M_Sa",
  "EI_Ch", "EI_Cu", "EI_I", "EI_E", "EI_P", "EI_D",
  "MC_S", "MC_P",
  "NE_N", "NE_O", "NE_C", "EQ",
  "LS", "FC", "gpa"
)]


# Remove rows with missing values
data_PCA1 <- na.omit(data_PCA1)


# PCA
pca_result1 <- prcomp(data_PCA1, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)


# Eigenvalues
eigenvalues1 <- pca_result1$sdev^2
eigenvalues1


# Kaiser rule: number of components with eigenvalue > 1
kaiser_components1 <- which(eigenvalues1 > 1)
kaiser_components1

n_components1 <- length(kaiser_components1)
n_components1


# Percentage of variance explained
variance_explained1 <- eigenvalues1 / sum(eigenvalues1)

variance_explained1 * 100


# Cumulative percentage of variance explained
cumulative_variance1 <- cumsum(variance_explained1)

cumulative_variance1 * 100


# PCA with Varimax rotation
pca_varimax1 <- psych::principal(
  data_PCA1,
  nfactors = n_components1,
  rotate = "varimax"
)


# Rotated component loadings
print(pca_varimax1$loadings, cutoff = 0.30)


# Scree plot
scree1 <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(eigenvalues1),
  Eigenvalue = eigenvalues1,
  Variance = variance_explained1,
  CumulativeVariance = cumulative_variance1,
  Keep = ifelse(eigenvalues1 > 1, "Keep", "Drop")
)


ggplot(scree1, aes(x = PC)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Eigenvalue)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Eigenvalue, color = Keep), size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(scree1, Keep == "Keep"),
    aes(
      y = Eigenvalue,
      label = paste0(
        "PC", PC, "\n",
        round(CumulativeVariance * 100, 1), "%"
      )
    ),
    nudge_y = 0.2,
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    aes(y = CumulativeVariance * max(eigenvalues1)),
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(y = CumulativeVariance * max(eigenvalues1)),
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Eigenvalue",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / max(eigenvalues1),
      name = "Cumulative Variance Explained",
      labels = scales::percent
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Scree Plot with Kaiser Rule & Cumulative Variance",
    x = "Principal Components",
    color = "Kaiser Rule"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()


```
